intro: Convert from MPa to ksi accurately for structural steel yield strength, ASTM tensile test reports, weld ratings, and bolt grade specifications. Because 1 ksi (1,000 psi) equals 6.89475729 megapascals under NIST and SI definitions, 1 MPa equals 0.14503774 ksi—simply divide MPa by 6.894757 (or multiply by 0.145038). Use the calculator above or scan common material strength values from 1 MPa to 1,000 MPa below.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: GPa vs. MPa Elastic Modulus Scaling & ksi vs. psi
items: Young's modulus (elastic modulus) is typically listed in gigapascals (GPa), where 1 GPa = 1,000 MPa = 145.03774 ksi (for example, structural steel at 200 GPa equals 29,007.55 ksi). Multiply GPa by 1,000 before entering a value in MPa.
1 ksi (sometimes written kpsi) equals 1,000 psi, and 1 MPa is numerically identical to 1 N/mm². Mixing up ksi and psi shifts stress limits by a factor of 1,000×.

faqs.question: How many ksi are in 1 MPa?
faqs.answer: 1 megapascal (MPa) equals 0.14504 ksi (1 ÷ 6.89475729). Conversely, 1 ksi equals 6.89476 MPa (1,000 psi).

faqs.question: How do you convert MPa to ksi?
faqs.answer: Divide megapascals by 6.89475729 (or multiply by 0.14503774): ksi = MPa ÷ 6.894757. For example, 250 MPa ÷ 6.894757 = 36.26 ksi.

faqs.question: Is kpsi the same unit as ksi?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both ksi and kpsi abbreviate kilopounds (1,000 pounds-force) per square inch, equal to 6.89476 MPa.
